# address: # Names identified while reverse engineering PeggleNights_inner.exe (the real game embedded in the PopCap launcher stub).
# Applied to the Ghidra project by scripts/reexport.ps1. Calling-convention notes: many internal functions were built with
# LTCG and take `this` in EAX or EBX instead of ECX -- noted per function. Virtual methods are normal __thiscall.
# ---- Random number generator (single global Mersenne Twister, seeded once at startup with 4357) ----

name: Sexy::MTRand_StaticInit
comment: Static initializer: seeds the global MT with 0x1105 (4357). Only seeding site in the game.

name: Sexy::MTRand_SRand
comment: MT19937 init_genrand on the global state (seed in EAX)

name: Sexy::MTRand_Next
comment: MT19937 genrand_int32 on the global state; returns in EAX

name: Sexy::Rand
comment: 5-byte JMP stub every game caller uses (-> 0x566c40 -> MTRand_Next). Mod hook point.

name: Sexy::gMTRand_state
comment: 624-dword MT19937 state of the global RNG

name: Sexy::WidgetContainer::UpdateAll
comment: Calls Update (vtable +0x58) once per WidgetManager update count

# address: # ---- Board (vtable for Widget @0x6864a4; second vptr @+0x88; Board_data starts at +0x8C; sizeof 0x988) ----

name: Sexy::Board::Update
comment: vtable slot 22 (+0x58). Fixed-step game tick; increments tick counter at +0x8D4

name: Sexy::Board::KeyUp
comment: vtable slot 49 (Enter key acts as a click)

name: Sexy::Board::MouseMove
comment: vtable slot 52 -> LogicMgr::MouseMove; ignored while AIMgr+0x4D set

name: Sexy::Board::SetupPlayers
comment: this=EBX. Per-level player/character setup; assigns computer opponent in Duel (mode 4)

# address: # ---- LogicMgr (Board+0x720). Fields: +0x04 state, +0x184 Board*, +0x1A8 two-player flag, +0x1AC current player,
#      +0x208[i] balls left per player, +0x2D8[i] player-is-computer flags ----

name: Sexy::LogicMgr::MouseMove
comment: this=EAX. Aims the gun unless current player is computer-controlled

name: Sexy::LogicMgr::MouseDown
comment: this=EBX. Fires / handles clicks depending on state (+0x04)

name: Sexy::LogicMgr::NextTurn
comment: this=EAX. Two-player: current = 1 - current, shows turn banner, resets shot state

name: Sexy::LogicMgr::SetupTurnOrder
comment: Picks the first player with Rand()&1 (anti-streak via globals 0x6C8068/0x7051C0)

name: Sexy::ThunderballApp::NewBoard_Mode2

name: Sexy::ThunderballApp::NewBoard_Mode5
